stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. «37.2 degrees.» « Temperatura: 37.2 » Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Aplicando «Locate a specific value in a note / Read the number after the label. / Reading for detail» al texto, ¿cuál de las opciones se sostiene?

options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "No temperature is given" for the governing rule

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: the note explicitly states 'Temperatura: 37.2. On that basis "37.2 degrees" is the supported choice. Option A ("38.0 degrees") fails because it rounds incorrectly; Option C ("36.5 degrees") fails because it misreads the value; Option D ("No temperature is given") fails because it mistakes a surface feature of "No temperature is given" for the governing rule.
questions.hint: Read the number after the label.

questions.subject: SPANISH

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: «Calm and reassuring.» « Paciente estable. Todo en orden » La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

questions.stem: La nota se contrasta con «Identify tone in a note / Neutral statements signal calm. / Tone». ¿qué respuesta queda respaldada?

options.misconception: misreads a calm note as urgent
overreads a calm note as anxious

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: short neutral statements signal a calm, reassuring tone. On that basis "Calm and reassuring" is the supported choice. Option A ("Alarmed and urgent") fails because it misreads a calm note as urgent; Option B ("Anxious and worried") fails because it overreads a calm note as anxious; Option D ("Sarcastic and dismissive") fails because it misreads neutrality as sarcasm.
questions.hint: Neutral statements signal calm.

stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. «A clinician conveys caution with hedging words like 'probable' or 'se recomienda', avoiding definitive claims.» Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Con «Hedging words signal caution.» presente, ¿qué respuesta se desprende de la nota?

answer.exemplar: A clinician conveys caution with hedging words like 'probable' or 'se recomienda', avoiding definitive claims.

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: hedging language signals caution. On that basis "A clinician conveys caution with hedging words like 'probable' or 'se recomienda', avoiding…" is the supported choice.
questions.hint: Hedging words signal caution.

questions.subject: SPANISH

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: «To evaluate the treatment response.» La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

questions.stem: Con la pista «The opening phrase states the purpose. — To evaluate the treatment response.». ¿qué respuesta queda respaldada?
questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: the opening phrase 'Objetivo: evaluar la respuesta al tratamiento' states the purpose directly. On that basis "To evaluate the treatment response" is the supported choice. Option A ("To prescribe new medication") fails because it confuses evaluation with prescription; Option B ("To discharge the patient") fails because it misreads evaluation as discharge; Option C ("To schedule surgery") fails because it overreads evaluation as surgical plan.
questions.hint: The opening phrase states the purpose.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: A thesis in an original passage

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: «Rest resolved the symptoms.» « El reposo resolvió los síntomas » La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

questions.stem: Aplicando «Identify thesis in a note / The thesis is the central claim. / A thesis in an original passage» al texto, ¿cuál de las opciones se sostiene?

options.misconception: picks a supporting detail as thesis
selects "No thesis is stated" where the rule in the passage requires a different condition

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: the thesis is the central claim: rest resolved the symptoms. On that basis "Rest resolved the symptoms" is the supported choice. Option D ("No thesis is stated") fails because it selects "No thesis is stated" where a thesis in an original passage requires a different condition. Option B ("The patient had a fever") fails because it picks a supporting detail as thesis. Option D ("No thesis is stated.") is wrong: selects "No thesis is stated" where the rule in the passage requires a different condition; Option B ("The patient had a fever.") is wrong: picks a supporting detail as thesis; Option C ("The ward was busy.") is wrong: introduces an unrelated claim.
questions.hint: The thesis is the central claim.
